name: @w6w-apps/ironclad
description: Launch and manage Ironclad contract workflows, read and write repository records and entities, and subscribe to contract events.

w6w.longDescription:
Ironclad is a contract lifecycle management platform: contracts are requested through launch forms, move through review, approval and signature as workflows, and land in a searchable repository of records tied to the legal entities behind them.

This app covers the three objects a contract automation touches. Workflows: launch one from a template, read and update its attributes, follow approvals, comments and signers, and pause, resume or cancel it. Records: list, read, create, update and delete the repository's contract records, and read the record schema so a workflow knows which properties exist. Entities: the counterparties and subsidiaries that records point at.

It also manages webhooks, so a flow can react to a contract being signed instead of polling for it, and reports the token's own user and granted scopes. Connections use OAuth 2.0, either the authorization code grant for a signed-in user or the client credentials grant for a service identity acting as a named user, against the US, EU or demo environment.
